shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab/monument
glyph-like or sign-like elements arranged in a block or column

justification: Both surfaces show low-relief carving on an upright monument combining an elaborately headdressed anthropomorphic figure/mask with curvilinear scroll motifs and blocky sign-like elements, a fairly specific conventional pairing. However, A presents a bilaterally symmetrical, frontal, columnar composition with a large central disc and encircling bands, whereas B shows an off-centre profile-oriented figure with cascading regalia and a dense glyph column at one edge, so the placement and composition differ substantially.
